title.narrative: UNICEF continued to enhance evidence on social service workforce strengthening (SSWS) through cross-border knowledge-sharing visits; utilized evidence to further strengthen advocacy efforts with parliamentarians for the enactment of the Social Work Profession (SWP) Bill; and initiated development of on-boarding capacity-building curricula for child protectors in collaboration with the Malaysian Association of Social Workers (MASW). UNICEF supported the government?s efforts to develop alternatives to immigration detention (ATD) for children by facilitating a study visit to Thailand on community-based ATD for children and families. The Office of the Children?s Commissioner (OCC) was further reinforced through provision of technical support.
